typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @MARKET VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @MARKET1 VARCHAR(100) DECLARE @MARKET2 VARCHAR(100)  SET @MARKET = SUBSTRING( CAST(? AS VARCHAR) ,1, CHARINDEX(\'|\',CAST(? AS VARCHAR))-1)  IF(CHARINDEX(\',\',@MARKET)!=0) 	BEGIN 		SET @MARKET1 = SUBSTRING( @MARKET ,1, CHARINDEX(\',\',@MARKET)-1)  		SET @MARKET2 = SUBSTRING( @MARKET ,CHARINDEX(\',\',REVERSE(@MARKET))+1, CHARINDEX(\',\',REVERSE(@MARKET))-1)  	END ELSE 	BEGIN 		SET @MARKET1 = @MARKET 		SET @MARKET2 = \'\'     END   SELECT       Market       ,Prescription_number       ,Claim_id       ,Member_id       ,Prescription_written_date       ,Prescription_fill_date       ,Prescription_refill_number       ,Claim_date_paid       ,Load_cycle_date       ,NDC       ,Quantity_dispensed       ,Days_supply       ,Compound_code       ,Generic       ,Formulary       ,Prescriber_id       ,Prescribing_provider_npi       ,Prescribing_provider_tax_id       ,Prescribing_provider_DEA_number       ,Pharmacy_id       ,Pharmacy_npi       ,Dispensing_fee_paid       ,Amount_total_paid       ,Claim_status       ,Employer_group_number       ,Lob       ,Plan_code FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[POMELO_PHARMACY_CLAIMS_EXTRACT] WHERE Market = @MARKET1  UNION   SELECT       Market       ,Prescription_number       ,Claim_id       ,Member_id       ,Prescription_written_date       ,Prescription_fill_date       ,Prescription_refill_number       ,Claim_date_paid       ,Load_cycle_date       ,NDC       ,Quantity_dispensed       ,Days_supply       ,Compound_code       ,Generic       ,Formulary       ,Prescriber_id       ,Prescribing_provider_npi       ,Prescribing_provider_tax_id       ,Prescribing_provider_DEA_number       ,Pharmacy_id       ,Pharmacy_npi       ,Dispensing_fee_paid       ,Amount_total_paid       ,Claim_status       ,Employer_group_number       ,Lob       ,Plan_code FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[POMELO_PHARMACY_CLAIMS_EXTRACT] WHERE Market = @MARKET2  ORDER BY Member_id ,Claim_id',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTablePOMELOPHARMACYCLAIMSEXTRACT
SourceTablePOMELOPHARMACYCLAIMSEXTRACT sink(input(
		Quantity_dispensed as string,
		Compound_code as string,
		Generic as string,
		Prescription_fill_date as string,
		Claim_status as string,
		NDC as string,
		Claim_id as string,
		Formulary as string,
		Claim_date_paid as string,
		Dispensing_fee_paid as string,

		Prescription_number as string,
		Prescriber_id as string,
		Prescription_refill_number as string,
		Load_cycle_date as string,
		Employer_group_number as string,
		Prescribing_provider_npi as string,
		Member_id as string,
		Prescribing_provider_tax_id as string,
		Prescribing_provider_DEA_number as string,
		Prescription_written_date as string,
		Pharmacy_id as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Quantity_dispensed,
		Compound_code,
		Generic,
		Prescription_fill_date,
		Claim_status,
		NDC,
		Claim_id,
